name: Sinzig (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, red and yellow in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Sinzig (a black eagle on yellow beneath a crown above a red castle).
history: Municipal flag of Sinzig; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Sinzig arms — eagle, crown and castle
